# Records

The formats a log record is written in: text or JSON lines.

<h2 id="log-format"><code>LogFormat</code></h2>

```rux
pub enum LogFormat: uint8 {
    Text = 0,
    JsonLines = 1
}
```

How records are written. `Copy`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Log/Src/Record.rux#L13)

**Cases**

| Name        | Value | Description                                                                                                                                           |
| ----------- | ----- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Text`      | `0`   | One line of text per record: the time, the level, the message, then each field as `key=value`, with values that hold spaces, quotes or `=` in quotes. |
| `JsonLines` | `1`   | One JSON object per line, with `time`, `level` and `message` members followed by the fields.                                                          |
